messages.author: Abdul-Rashid III Sampaco
messages.body:
Dear AMBER Developers,
Are there any plans to fix pytraj to make it compatible with python 3.9?
It does not import in python 3.9 right now. I have attached the error
message I encountered. Based on how I understand it, there are some changes
in python 3.9 which affected the code.
Rashid

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Jan 06, 2021, Abdul-Rashid III Sampaco wrote:
>
>Are there any plans to fix pytraj to make it compatible with python 3.9?
>It does not import in python 3.9 right now. I have attached the error
>message I encountered. Based on how I understand it, there are some changes
>in python 3.9 which affected the code.
It looks to me like you built Amber using python 3.8, since your files
are all in places like ...amber18/lib/python3.8/site-packages/.... To use
these files, you should use the version of python that Amber was built with.
If you need python3.9, then re-configure AmberTools with python 3.9. While
you are at it, download AmberTools20 to take advantage of two years worth of
improvements and bug fixes.
....dac
caveat: I am no python guru!

messages.author: Abdul-Rashid III Sampaco
messages.body:
Thanks, Dr. Case! My bad. I didn't realize I needed to recompile Amber
after upgrading to 3.9. I also downloaded AmberTools20.
Rashid
